english.title: Fail to report damage to aircraft / airside equipment - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to report damage to or damage caused to

(A)_[an aircraft,]_
(B)_[airside equipment or apparatus,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT OR EQUIPMENT..), at Liverpool John Lennon Airport to its owner or a person having charge of it
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 3(31) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationwhere damage was caused to an aircraft OR to airside equipment or apparatuswithout reasonable excusefailed to report the damage to the owner or person in charge of it

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Byelaw 1(3) states that the offence will not be committed by any member of a fire, police or ambulance service acting in the course of their duty or to any emergency vehicle being used by such a person.
